headline: A real answer starts with a source response, not prose.
copy: This contract tells the future backend what the UI is allowed to trust: source id, citation, family, confidence, reviewer state, rights posture, and no-source decision.

fields.name: query
fields.why: Keeps the user's intent visible for trace and review.

fields.name: primary_source_id
fields.why: Prevents uncited answers from looking complete.

fields.name: reviewer_state
fields.why: Separates approved records from hold or review records.

fields.name: boundary
fields.why: Keeps category, ritual, medical, and authority limits visible.

required.value: source id, citation, family, confidence, trace id

records.title: Steady action
records.summary: Supports practical answers about steady action while avoiding promises of guaranteed calm.
records.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

records.title: Oppenheimer category correction
records.summary: Supports correcting the common claim: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
records.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

records.title: Gayatri mantra care
records.summary: Useful for source context, but learner-facing practice needs reviewer and rights review.
records.boundary: No ritual instruction, initiation advice, or recitation authority.

records.title: Stewardship and restraint
records.summary: Can support careful answers about possession and restraint if commentary and rights notes are visible.
records.boundary: Do not flatten the verse into wealth advice or productivity advice.

records.title: Modern aircraft overclaim
records.summary: Used to refuse inflated claims when no reviewed source can carry the answer.
records.boundary: Say no reliable source is present; do not invent validation.

response.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.

rules.title: No source, no answer
rules.copy: If no reviewed source is returned, the answer adapter must use no-source behavior.

rules.title: Reviewer state travels
rules.copy: Approved, review, hold, and no-source states must stay visible in the answer layer.

rules.title: Rights are data
rules.copy: Translation display and public reuse must remain disabled until rights fields are present.
